items.rationale: Authentication gate controls all write operations.
Core create behavior must be stable for downstream flows.
Missing required response fields breaks clients and traceability.
Duplicate-title handling is business-relevant but not a security gate.
Empty title validation failure impacts data quality.
Empty description validation failure impacts API contract compliance.
Empty body validation failure causes invalid content records.
Unauthenticated create must be rejected for security.
Owner update behavior is core write path.
Partial update semantics are easy to regress and hard to detect later.
Omitted tagList preservation is a critical rule-combination case.
Empty-array semantics can silently corrupt tag metadata.
Null tagList rejection prevents malformed states.
Persistence verification detects hidden state-write failures.
Delete behavior for owner must be trustworthy.
Post-delete retrieval failure confirms data lifecycle consistency.
